items.title: Centralized multi-account server migration to AWS with AWS Transform
items.summary: Introduction AWS Transform for migrations lets you orchestrate a centralized, multi-account migration of your workloads to Amazon EC2 from a single location. It coordinates the migration across all your target accounts and applies AI-powered automation to dependency mapping, wave planning, and network configuration, so dependent workloads move together while landing in their intended destination accounts.
